question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Ideal
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Flawed'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ideal"** refers to something that is conceived as perfect, existing only in one's imagination; not practical or realizable.(आदर्श)
 
• **It signifies** a standard of perfection or excellence. In Hindi, "Ideal" translates to "".
 
• **"Flawed": **This word refers to something that has blemishes, defects, or shortcomings.(दोषयुक्त)
 
• In this context, it is the antonym of **"Ideal"** as it signifies the opposite, **i.e., imperfection.**

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Flawed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **"Fitting":** This word means suitable or appropriate. (उपयुक्त).
